description: Create or replace a customer-supplied panel bridge on an owned BYOP study. Supply completion and screen-out redirect URLs; set the provider's respondent ID query parameter and placeholder if the defaults differ. Optional session, external study, quota-full, and technical-failure mappings are supported. Before sharing entry_url with the provider, call get_study, verify provisioning_status=provisioned, and have the human approve the current plan and URL mapping. This does not recruit respondents or launch the paid User Intuition Panel. Repeating the same PUT preserves the current entry token.

complete_redirect_url.description: Provider URL for respondents who finish the interview.

external_study_id_param.description: Query parameter carrying the provider's study identifier.

external_study_id_placeholder.description: Provider substitution token for the external study identifier.

organization_id.description: Organization for this operation and billing. Use list_organizations to choose an active membership.

provider.description: External panel provider whose redirect and identifier conventions apply.

quota_full_redirect_url.description: Provider URL for respondents whose quota is already full.

respondent_id_param.description: Query parameter carrying the provider's respondent identifier.

respondent_id_placeholder.description: Provider substitution token for the respondent identifier.

screenout_redirect_url.description: Provider URL for respondents who do not qualify.

session_id_param.description: Query parameter carrying the provider's session identifier.

session_id_placeholder.description: Provider substitution token for the session identifier.

study_id.description: UUID of the study, as returned by list_studies.

technical_redirect_url.description: Provider URL for respondents who encounter a technical failure.

name: configure_external_panel
title: Configure External Panel
